thesis: The page is an ascent: each section is a place on the road out of Santa Fe, and the altitude marker on the margin climbs as you scroll, tying every maintenance task to the elevation that demands it.

signature.name: Altitude Marker Rail
signature.summary: A monospaced vertical rail on the left margin (sticky on desktop, inline pill on mobile) that reads the current section's elevation and place name; counts up via --sw-p as sections enter view. Reused in hero, story bands, review tags, and footer reset.

palette.family: Night Sky + Turquoise Door + Adobe Dust

motion.intro: Centered statement fades in letter-by-letter (stagger 40ms, total 600ms); sticky photo unclips via inset wipe. Skippable via any interaction.
stories: Altitude marker rail counts up between sections via --sw-p; numbers tick in mono, 900ms ease-io.
Three short statements scroll past the sticky adobe-wall photo; each ties a maintenance task to the elevation shown.
motion.hover: Hairline rule grows from left (scaleX 0→1) under interactive elements, 200ms, accent color.
